prompt_template:
Task instruction: {instruction}
Pinpoint several points on the visible surface of the object described as: {role}. Preserve the instance and spatial qualifiers in that description. Your answer should be formatted as a list of tuples, i.e. [(x1, y1), (x2, y2), ...]. The coordinates should be between 0 and 1, indicating normalized pixel locations with a top-left origin.
quantization: 8bit; supported upstream option, not full-precision paper replication
point_selection: First returned point; no mask-dependent selection or correction
query_granularity: One RGB query per instruction-derived role; 39 queries for 20 tasks
